verdict.rationale: Supabase docs say there are several ways to connect to Postgres, including from a serverless function. Its APIs are auto-generated from the database (type-safe REST definitions plus a pg_graphql GraphQL API), which suggests HTTP-based querying from Edge Functions. However, nothing in the pack describes an official driver built for short-lived connections, and the WebSocket path covers only Realtime messaging and change feeds, not general querying. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official HTTP/WebSocket query driver for serverless/edge, connection pooling or short-lived-connection handling, WebSocket-based querying, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
